cards.title: Finite-chain Aubry-Andre Hamiltonian

source_refs.value: Published Eq. (1); arXiv source label e2

cards.role: Defines the quasiperiodic single-particle lattice and its localization transition.

checks.reason: Each nearest-neighbor hop is paired with its Hermitian conjugate and the onsite potential is real.
At chi=0 the implementation reproduces the analytic open-chain sine spectrum; the periodic option adds only the closing bond.
Boundary conditions are target-local: periodic boundaries remove the four edge-state IPR spikes absent from source Fig. 2, while open boundaries are retained for the site-resolved density in Fig. S1.
The paper states the AA localization transition at chi/J=2 for the golden-ratio modulation.

cards.numerical_form: Real symmetric nearest-neighbor matrix with diagonal chi*cos(2*pi*gamma*j), off-diagonal -J, and an optional periodic closing bond selected per target.

cards.title: Generalized Aubry-Andre corrections

source_refs.value: Published Eq. (2); arXiv source label e3

cards.role: Creates the GAA mobility edge used in Fig. 2.

checks.reason: All correction hoppings have real amplitudes and explicit Hermitian conjugates.
Fig. 2 caption prints J'/J=-0.23, J2/J=0.072 and chi'/J=-0.016.

cards.numerical_form: Real symmetric pentadiagonal matrix added to EQ001.

cards.title: Steady-state cavity amplitude
cards.role: Maps an atomic density profile to the complex cavity field and photon number.

checks.reason: The complex steady-state field is explicit in published Eq. (3) and supplement Eq. (S5).
a=0 when eta=0 or when the density overlap Theta vanishes.
|a|^2=eta^2 N^2 Theta^2/[(-Delta_c+UNB)^2+kappa^2] is nonnegative.

cards.numerical_form: Evaluate Theta and B from a normalized real orbital, then evaluate the printed complex rational function.
open_questions: The literal one-factor denominator is retained. The factor-two value is tested only after generation as a hypothesis for the Fig. 3(a)/Fig. 4(b) normalization conflict.

cards.title: Cavity scattering overlaps and susceptibility channels

source_refs.value: Published Eqs. (4)-(6) and definitions below Eq. (6)

cards.role: Connects the AA/GAA eigenstates to the cavity-induced linear response.

checks.reason: The overlap matrices and channel susceptibility are explicit below published Eqs. (4)-(6).
Every ground-state channel is nonnegative because epsilon_beta-epsilon_0>0.
Completeness gives sum_beta |S_0beta|^2=<0|C^2|0>.

cards.numerical_form: Diagonalize H, form S=V.T @ diag(C) @ V, and divide squared row-0 overlaps by excitation energies.

cards.title: Linear superradiant threshold

source_refs.value: Published Eqs. (3)-(6), used for the independent linearization

cards.role: Turns the cavity susceptibility into the critical pump plotted in Figs. 2-4.

checks.reason: Published Eq. (7) explicitly defines the one-factor shifted detuning barDelta_c=Delta_c-UNh0.
First-order perturbation gives Theta=-2 eta f1(a+a*) and the nonzero fixed-point condition yields Eq. (7).
The SciPy eigensolver, analytic open-chain sine basis, direct scalar threshold transcription, and Bloch-channel limit agree without reference-curve input.
The literal result is frozen before comparison. An undeclared factor-two branch is recorded only as a falsification hypothesis because it matches both plotted normalizations.

cards.numerical_form: Use the literal one-factor published detuning in every scientific array. Evaluate any factor-two branch only in the post-generation claim-discrepancy check; never tune it from the paper curve.
open_questions: Fresh-context review must adjudicate the stable conflict between literal Eq. (7) and the absolute normalization of Fig. 3(a)/Fig. 4(b).

cards.title: Localization-driven resonant self-scattering

source_refs.value: Fig. 2 discussion and paragraphs below Fig. 3

cards.role: Defines the central mechanism: a localized state has finite diagonal cavity overlap and therefore a resonant zero-denominator channel.

checks.reason: The IPR definition, finite self-overlap, and divergent self-channel are stated in the Fig. 2-3 discussion.
For an extended normalized state, IPR and generic diagonal cavity overlap vanish with system size.
For a state localized at j_l, S_alphaalpha approaches cos(2*pi*gamma_c*j_l), as stated by the paper.
At the Fig. 2 parameters an IPR threshold of 0.05 separates GAA states 0-232 from 233-376 and classifies every AA state at chi/J=2.1 as localized.

cards.numerical_form: At finite L, classify localization from IPR rather than treating small boundary-induced S_alphaalpha as a true thermodynamic self channel; assign eta_c=0 to localized states.
open_questions: The finite-size IPR cutoff is not printed; 0.05 is fixed by the paper's stated mobility-edge index and recorded in config.

cards.title: Momentum distribution and channel indices
cards.role: Explains the momentum peaks and the three dominant scattering channels in Fig. 3.

checks.reason: The Fourier observable and analytic channel indices are printed in the Fig. 3 discussion.
The 1/L normalization keeps the discrete Fourier probability on the paper's plotted scale.
For L=377, gamma_c=0.8 and the exact golden-ratio gamma the predicted indices round to alpha0=151, alpha1=137 and alpha2=27, matching the labeled source channels.

cards.numerical_form: Evaluate the direct Fourier sum on q in [-2,2] and calculate per-eigenstate f1 channels from EQ004.

cards.title: Self-consistent mean-field orbital

source_refs.value: Supplement Eqs. (S1)-(S5) and Fig. S1 discussion

cards.role: Defines the nonlinear fixed point used for the photon-number and density panels.

checks.reason: At eta=0 the fixed point reduces exactly to the unperturbed AA ground state.
Every eigensolve returns a unit-normalized orbital and the density sums to one.
The supplement states that the weak cavity field further localizes the chi/J=2.03 state.

cards.numerical_form: Iterate cavity field and the lowest eigenvector with damping; use continuation from the superradiant side to avoid losing the broken-symmetry branch. Exact iteration tolerance and pump samples are case-local reconstruction details.
open_questions: The supplement does not print the pump values or iterative solver used for Fig. S1.
